scripts.dev: chcp 65001 > nul && set "NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1" && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:client: chcp 65001 > nul && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev:server: chcp 65001 > nul && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
